hero.title: Dance and fitness classes in central Eastbourne
hero.subtitle: Our friendly Cherry Dance studios offer a professional, supportive and fun space. Join us for a variety of classes with quality teaching tailored to each student.

classes.heading: Classes & timetable
classes.intro: Pole, aerial, yolates and dance — weekday evenings in the centre of Eastbourne.
classes.note: Times below are as published on cherry-dance.com. Workshops appear on the live TeamUp schedule.

groups.name: Dance
sessions: Cherry Long Stockings Performance Troupe: Wednesdays 8pm

classes.privateNote: One or two-to-one private classes at a time to suit you. In addition to the classes listed, Cherry Dance offers choreography, wedding dances, Bollywood, breakdance, contemporary, release, commercial, ballet, pointe, pas de deux, yoga, pilates, stretch & flex, jazz and modern ISTD.

booking.heading: Book a class
booking.body: Class bookings run through TeamUp (GoTeamUp). Open the live schedule to pick a session, including regular classes and workshops.
booking.teamUpNote: The TeamUp schedule is the place to book. The original Wix site also embeds booking widgets; this site sends you straight to TeamUp.
booking.privateNote: For private classes, email the studio — one or two-to-one sessions can be arranged at a time that suits you.

shop.heading: Studio shop
shop.body: Uniform and merch live on the existing Cherry Dance shop. Children’s and adults’ sizes are available.

items.name: Uniform top
items.detail: £15 if purchased separately. Sizes Small, Medium, Large, Extra Large. Children’s and adults’ sizes available.

items.name: Uniform shorts
items.detail: £35 if purchased separately. Sizes Small, Medium, Large, Extra Large. Children’s and adults’ sizes available.

items.name: Merch
items.detail: Additional studio merch is listed on the shop (men’s, women’s and children’s sizes where offered).

cabaret.name: Cabaret Cerises
cabaret.description: Burlesque and cabaret shows founded by Cheryl Cooper with Simon Drake. About six shows a year in Eastbourne theatres. Adult-only.

performances.title: Cabaret Cerises: 10 Years of Burlesque
performances.notes: 20% of proceeds to Epilepsy Society. Venue page marked the event as passed.

instructors.heading: Instructors
instructors.note: All Cherry Dance instructors are fully qualified, insured and first aid trained.
